paper_title: Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism
caption: : The distribution of different input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs, over the WildChat conversations that are matched to online articles from the two identified news agencies.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of stimulus types provided by journalists to Large Language Models (LLMs). The chart contains nine slices, representing different categories of stimulus material. These include “Draft/Other” which is red and accounts for 26.4% of the total, “Stimulus Type” in the center occupying a significant portion of the circle, “Press Release” colored yellow at 18.7%, “External News Article” colored dark green at 18.1%, “Interview” colored dark blue at 8.8%, “Event Posting” colored purple at 6.6%, “Organizational Report” colored a lighter purple at 7.7%, “Organizational Website” colored dark teal at 4.9%, “Intra-agency news article” colored dark green at 4.9%, and “Social Media Post” colored lime green at 1.1%. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and the segments appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion. A legend is not present, but each slice is directly labeled.
